message: fix(ci): blog autopost opens PR instead of pushing to protected main (#38)
post:
This past week has been focused on tightening up our internal processes and making our application more robust, particularly around the Apply Kit. We've been working to ensure that the Apply Kit is easily discoverable, linking it from key areas like the sidebar and dashboard. We also added end-to-end tests to verify its core functionality and refined its placement with a clearer call to action on the applications page.

Behind the scenes, we've been strengthening our security by protecting the /apply route with authentication, ensuring only authorized users can access this sensitive area. We also made improvements to our UI components, like a custom Checkbox, to enhance user experience.

A significant theme has emerged in how we manage our development workflow. We've been addressing potential security vulnerabilities identified by CodeQL, fixing issues related to sanitization, escaping, and regular expressions. This focus on code quality and security extends to our continuous integration pipeline. In a notable change, our blog autopost now opens a pull request instead of directly pushing to the protected main branch. This shift provides an extra layer of review and control, ensuring that all content updates are carefully considered before being merged.

This evolution in our CI/CD process reflects a broader commitment to building a more secure and reliable platform through deliberate, staged workflows.

How do you approach introducing changes to your core development processes?
